name: cyber-defense
description: Agent skills for running sandboxed cyber-defense capability evaluations through promptfoo and mapping coverage onto a NIST-CSF/D3FEND defender taxonomy.

interface.shortDescription: Run sandboxed cyber-defense capability evals and map defender coverage
interface.longDescription: Cyber-defense skills for running sandboxed blue-team capability evaluations through promptfoo — the model patches vulnerable services, writes detections, and investigates incidents, while deterministic two-sided scorers verify the threat is closed without breaking legitimate function, and map task coverage onto a NIST-CSF 2.0 / MITRE D3FEND defender taxonomy.
defaultPrompt: Run a sandboxed cyber-defense eval against my model.
Score whether the model's patch closes the exploit without breaking the service.
Map these blue-team tasks onto the NIST-CSF/D3FEND defender coverage map.
